title: pdftract grep JSON-Lines output
description: One match per line in JSON format. Each line is a separate JSON object with match metadata.

MatchEvent.description: A single grep match with full metadata (default output mode)

path.description: Path to the PDF file (relative if input was relative, absolute if input was absolute)

page_index.description: 0-based page index (machine convention; human output flips to 1-based)

bbox.description: Bounding box in PDF user-space coordinates [x0, y0, x1, y1]

span_text.description: The full span text containing the match

span_confidence.description: Confidence score (0.0 to 1.0). Omitted (null) if not applicable (e.g., non-OCR text or NaN/Infinity values).

pdf_fingerprint.description: PDF structural fingerprint for deduplication across runs

crosses_spans.description: Whether the match crosses multiple spans. Omitted when false to keep typical lines short.

path.description: Path to the PDF file with at least one match

count.description: Number of matches in this file
